## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Rheinland-Pfalz lights up on the map of Germany.
> Rheinland-Pfalz | Landeshauptstadt Mainz

[dramatic] [[Rheinland-Pfalz]], Rhineland-Palatinate, in the west, borders France, Luxembourg and Belgium. Its capital is Mainz, on the Rhine, and it grows more wine than any other state.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Rhineland-Palatinate, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> RHEINLAND-PFALZ

## On the map

{Q408}

> SCENE (question): Question card #408. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Rheinland-Pfalz?]] Which state is Rhineland-Palatinate?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[1]]. Number one: the west, along the borders with Luxembourg and France.


{Q407}

> SCENE (question): Question card #407. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Rheinland-Pfalz heißt …]] The state capital of Rhineland-Palatinate is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Mainz.]] The other three are real cities in Rhineland-Palatinate, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q405}

> SCENE (question): Question card #405. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Rheinland-Pfalz?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Rhineland-Palatinate?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[schwarz-rot-gold]]. Black, red and gold, like the German flag, with the coat of arms on it.


{Q401}

> SCENE (question): Question card #401. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Rheinland-Pfalz?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the state of Rhineland-Palatinate?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 1]], picture one: a red cross, a white wheel and a golden lion, under a crown of leaves.


## How it's run

{Q402}

> SCENE (question): Question card #402. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Rheinland-Pfalz?]] Which of these is a district (Landkreis) in Rhineland-Palatinate?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Westerwaldkreis]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Altötting]] is in [[Bayern]], [[Emsland]] is in [[Niedersachsen]], and [[Prignitz]] is in [[Brandenburg]].


{Q403}

> SCENE (question): Question card #403. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Rheinland-Pfalz gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament (Landtag) in Rhineland-Palatinate elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q404}

> SCENE (question): Question card #404. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Rheinland-Pfalz bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] At what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Rhineland-Palatinate?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[18]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from eighteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q409}

> SCENE (question): Question card #409. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Rheinland-Pfalz?]] What is the head of government in Rhineland-Palatinate called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q410}

> SCENE (question): Question card #410. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Rheinland-Pfalz nicht?]] Which minister does Rhineland-Palatinate not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q406}

> SCENE (question): Question card #406. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Rheinland-Pfalz über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political topics in Rhineland-Palatinate?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Mainz, schwarz-rot-gold, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Mainz]]. [[schwarz-rot-gold]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
